name: coord-jump
description: Browser extension: highlight text containing latitude/longitude and jump straight to it in Google Maps

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --source-dir . --ignore-files test package.json package-lock.json node_modules
scripts.start:firefox: web-ext run --source-dir . --ignore-files test package.json package-lock.json node_modules
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --ignore-files test package.json package-lock.json node_modules --overwrite-dest
